name: Pairgate
description: Ranks one real-time join between a contact and a resource, and publishes an interval summary for a scheduling agent. Pairgate does not edit the schedule.

skills.name: Rank one join
skills.description: Rank a capped candidate pool for one arriving contact or one newly free resource. Reads only the decision cache. Returns an ordered list or an ordinary-route order. This skill stays inside the join budget and does not call a model.
examples: A contact just arrived on the care line. Rank the available people.
A person just became free. Rank the waiting contacts who are still inside the wait guard.

skills.name: Publish an interval summary
skills.description: Return the closed-interval summary for one line of work: breach rate, scarce cohorts, and resource coverage scores. A scheduling agent uses this artifact to choose a later schedule edit. The summary contains no contact profiles and no model weights.
examples: The quarter-hour just closed. Send the summary a scheduling agent can score.

skills.name: Explain a completed decision
skills.description: After a join has already been applied, explain which cached features produced the top score. A supervisor agent may call a model here. The routing engine must not call this skill on the join path.
examples: Explain decision 8f2c. Which features put this resource first?
